status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Retro VHS
summary: Analog warmth and archival character without sacrificing clarity.
use_when: Use for nostalgic campaigns, story introductions, and informal creative explainers.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Georgia serif headings; system monospace short metadata.
layout: Framed archival feel with precise content hierarchy.
surfaces: Warm paper, restrained grain, subtle timestamp-like decorative labels.
exclude: False timestamps presented as recorded evidence

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Retro VHS to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings; system monospace short metadata. Framed archival feel with precise content hierarchy. Warm paper, restrained grain, subtle timestamp-like decorative labels. Palette: background #eee3c9, surface #fff7e5, text #40362f, muted #6e5e50, accent #78502e, border #c9b28d. Essential traits: Warm archival palette; Subtle analog texture; Clean foreground text. Avoid: Glitching instructions; Flicker; False timestamps presented as recorded evidence. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
